name: io.github.google/google-secops-mcp
title: Google Security Operations SIEM MCP Server
description: Google Security Operations SIEM MCP server for UDM search, alerts, entities, and YARA-L 2.0 rules

environmentVariables.name: CHRONICLE_PROJECT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Google Cloud project ID bound to the Google Security Operations tenant.

environmentVariables.name: CHRONICLE_REGION
environmentVariables.description: Google Security Operations regional endpoint code.

environmentVariables.name: SECOPS_SA_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a Google Cloud service account JSON key file.

environmentVariables.name: SECOPS_IMPERSONATE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT
environmentVariables.description: Optional service account email to impersonate via Google Cloud IAM.

region.description: Google Security Operations regional API prefix (for example us, eu, or europe-west2).

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: OAuth 2.0 Bearer token with cloud-platform scope.

headers.name: x-goog-user-project
headers.description: Google Cloud project ID used for quota and tenant routing.
